name: Tribes & Thrones
summary: Tribes & Thrones is a free-to-play fantasy city-building and strategy game for browser and mobile, played in rounds by up to 150 players. Two factions fight for a single throne: the Empire (humans, elves and dwarves) and the Free Peoples (orcs, wildlings and dark elves), six peoples in total. Players gather wood, stone, iron, food and gold, research a tech tree, forge weapons and armour, train armies, found further cities and raid camps and beasts in the borderlands. Battles are resolved automatically on the server without rock-paper-scissors counters; mixed armies deal more damage. Factions join forces in war marches to take watch fortresses, which become their castles, and the faction with the most glory at the end of the round wins. Capitals cannot be conquered and strength cannot be bought. The game is available in English and German, an Android app is planned for Google Play.
